name: accepts an empty graph and multiple independent rooted trees
input: empty edges and a two-root forest
test:
assert is_valid_forest([]) is True
assert is_valid_forest([('root-a', 'left'), ('root-a', 'right'), ('root-b', 'leaf')]) is True

name: rejects duplicate exact edges and shared children
input: one duplicated parent-child edge and one node with two parents
test:
assert is_valid_forest([('a', 'b'), ('a', 'b')]) is False
assert is_valid_forest([('a', 'child'), ('other', 'child')]) is False

name: rejects self loops and longer directed cycles
input: a self loop and a three-node cycle with a tail
test:
assert is_valid_forest([('node', 'node')]) is False
assert is_valid_forest([('root', 'a'), ('a', 'b'), ('b', 'c'), ('c', 'a')]) is False
